race.comment: JUST MY LOT (10) finds a nice race to break through. She just missed two back at Warrnambool behind a progressive horse before another sound effort there as favourite. Like her getting to 1600m now on a quick backup and with Meech sticking she'll be very hard to run down. TAMWOOD (8) was rising sharply from 1400m to 2000m last start which was a tough ask. Back in the sweet spot now and can figure in a fairly winnable affair. ROLLIN'ONTHERIVER (12) is a mare by Raise The Flag on debut who can run well for the Wilde yard, this is a solid kick off point for a stoutly bred mare. PETE THE PROPHET (5) was just fair fresh at Pakenham Synthetic but should be a sharp improver here onto turf.
